BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Secret used to sign Better Auth session cookies. Generate once per installation with `openssl rand -base64 32`; keep it across redeployments.

DB.description: D1 database that stores all Lead Desk data. Name it whatever you like during install - migrations run against the `DB` binding, so renaming the database is safe.

SETUP_TOKEN.description: Invite token required to create a staff account. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Rotate it in the dashboard if it leaks.

STAFF_EMAILS.description: Comma-separated staff emails allowed to sign in, for example `you@company.com,teammate@company.com`. Change it later in the dashboard without redeploying.

description: A Cloudflare-native, self-hosted CRM for inbound lead teams.
name: cloudflare-lead-desk

scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
